notes.note: Williams has been the surprise packet this year with a huge score this week with 7 clearances and a huge 15 hit outs to advantage which boosted his score.
Williams was good against Cameron and finished the second highest scoring Eagle this week. He has proven to be a great pickup for owners.
34 hit outs for the big man with 13 disposals. He has been more than serviceable for owners of late.
Williams put up a good showing against Jackson and Cox ending with a handy 26 hit outs and 12 disposals.
45 hit outs for Williams as he outdid the Lion's rucks combined this week Add to that 16 disposals and it was a solid night for the Eagles big man.
Williams was up against Lobb this week and won the hit out battle with 35but did have just the 6 disposals.
Williams is still providing some good scoring but he isn't one that you would trust on field as a ruck but he is posting respectable F6 numbers.

Just 15 points at half time but a couple of goals in the second half helped his score. If you are still holding it is time to upgrade to one of the key rucks unless you are holding him as your ruck cover.
Williams had a tough task with Xerri but managed to get one of just three scores over 100 for the Eagles this week. 14 disposals and 26 hit outs with a game high 8 to advantage.
Williams was better this week against Sweet posting a 92 with 29 hit outs and 12 disposals.

A fall back to the scoring we have been used to for Williams this week with his 11 disposals 17 hit outs and goal. He could still rise in value this week with a good BE but it could be the end of the road after that.

Back to back huge scores for Williams with his 18 contested possessions and 12 clearances along with his 20 disposals. It is still a risk that his scoring could disappear at any moment but ride the wave if you won him.
One out of the box for Williams from 41 hit outs 2 goals 7 clearances and 9 tackles. This won't happen every week but if Darcy Cameron isn't back for Collingwood this week he could go big again.
Williams was better but you aren't going to want him in your side for too long.
We were worried about people trading him in after that good score and it turned out to be with good reason. Just 13 hitouts and 7 disposals for his 58.
